listing.name: NeverDead — NeverDead — Native PC Port (Xbox 360 Static Recompilation) (mateussmeneses)
listing.summary: The project reports in-game scenes, input, audio, saves and limited benchmarks. These results do not establish campaign completion. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own NeverDead Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Title 4B4E081F.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run documented ReXGlue codegen/CMake build and point runtime at own NeverDead disc dump.

warnings: The project reports in-game scenes, input, audio, saves and limited benchmarks. These results do not establish campaign completion.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
